svg.title: MemoSight — images in, structured validated JSON out
svg.desc: MemoSight logo, the promise "images in, structured JSON out", and a diagram showing a photo transformed by the MemoSight pipeline into a validated JSON observation with caption, scene labels, mood, and search tags.

g.text: Visual understanding through a local mlx-vlm server —
validated, algorithm-ready output. No cloud API required.
